precommit_anchor.commit_subject_and_body:
P6R Checkpoint A: precommit the repaired protocol (TUNE only, no EVAL)

This commit is the temporal anchor the original P6 campaign lacked, and it is
the repair for adjudication blocking defect 3.  It contains the whole
precommitment and no confirmation result of any kind.

Frozen here, before any P6R EVAL run:

  * theorem scope.  T6-B unchanged and EXACT_VALID, with its memoryless policy
    class pinned field by field (the eight observable-but-excluded fields are
    named).  T6-C stated exactly and FOR FIXED k ONLY; the scalar Jensen formula
    is explicitly not claimed for adaptive k, and no adaptive-k theorem is
    manufactured.  Every headline cell fixes k.
  * baseline selection (repairs blocking defect 1).  Rule S1: TUNE only, fine
    grid rho in {0.05, 0.06, ..., 0.35}, Delta = 1, 150,000 replicates per grid
    point, centred 5-point moving average, ties on smoothed Dq95 then smaller
    rho.  Selected rho*_TUNE: cusum m=1 0.24, m=2 0.19, m=3 0.20, m=5 0.17;
    sr m=1 0.22, m=2 0.21, m=3 0.23, m=5 0.19.  The adjudication identified 0.25
    for the primary cell; rule S1 independently selects 0.20, so BOTH are
    carried as declared controls and the headline must survive against
    whichever is less favourable to SAW-M.
  * statistical procedure (repairs blocking defect 2).  Exactly 10,000
    resamples, BCa with a real jackknife (closed form for ratios of means, exact
    leave-one-out for ratios of quantiles), a normal interval beside every BCa
    interval, ratios bootstrapped as ratios over replicate pairs, BH-FDR at
    q = 0.10 over four declared families, a 200-event tail floor.  Tests assert
    each element is executed rather than merely available.
  * cost definitions.  C_fresh renamed fresh-sample ACQUISITION cost; two
    declared sensitivities (proportional and quadratic/effective).  The only
    permitted primary claim is equality of newly acquired samples per update.
  * Delta scope.  Delta = 1 primary; Delta = 0.5 predeclared as a limitation
    and SAW-M is not altered to target it; Delta = 2 tail claims gated on the
    event floor with Dq95 as the declared fallback.
  * calibration audit.  6 of 8 cells converged; cusum_m2 and sr_m3 did not.
    "All cells converged" is false and is not claimed.  s1 rests on 0 to 3,653
    observations depending on cell; the final large-pass refit was NOT followed
    by another fixed-point update.  The predeclared sparse-cell sensitivity was
    run for every cell: perturbing s1 to 0.5x, 2x and s0 moves mean rho by at
    most 0.66%, reference RMS by 0.96% and ARL0 by 3.73%.
  * closure rule, twelve conditions, unedited.

The method itself is untouched: SAW-M, the chain and the frozen detector are
imported from the adjudicated rebaseguard_p6c package rather than
re-implemented, and a test forbids re-implementing them.  The historical P6
namespaces are hashed here (121 files) and a test asserts they never change.

confirm_eval.py refuses to run until results/precommit_anchor.json records this
commit's SHA.
